QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Alex, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to greet #b#p402##k, a resident of the city. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the cityspeople is a given, right? \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I greeted #p402#, a resident of #m10003000#. As expected, the residents of this city seem to be quite full of personality.

0.0: "There isn't a whole lot you're forced to do as a resident of #m10003000#, but hey, if you're up for it, I'd highly recommend chatting with the locals around here. I'm actually curious if #p402# is still hanging around the city, so why don't you go over and say hi to him?\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: Huh? Who're you? What? You're a new resident of #m10003000#? Heh... You've got some pretty unique taste. I like you already!
1.1: Guess I should properly introduce myself, then. Name's #p402#. I ran away from home and started crashing here, but I realized this city is actually pretty sweet, and before I knew it, I ended up becoming a resident myself.
1.2: Should I be congratulating you on becoming a resident here? Well, I guess you'll figure that out for yourself as you live here. Catch ya later!

level.0: But you... your level is, like, way too low?
